Blocking criteria are listed for the trustees
expectations.evidence: Both graders agree (pass / pass). A: The reply ties the L1 block to the accessibility findings and lists them in plain words: "The first level is blocked by two things: - Open accessibility problems: the six listed below. - Checks that haven't run: ...", then "No focus outline: form fields show no visible outline, so keyboard users can't see where they are", "Paste blocked: the password field blocks pasting, which gets in the way of password managers", "Pale hint text ... 2.5:1 contrast; the minimum is 4.5:1", "Faint borders ... 1.4:1; the minimum is 3:1", "Small buttons ... 20 px; the minimum is 24 px". Both examples in the test are covered (2.4.7 focus, 3.3.8 paste blocking). The report pairs the same items with their criteria: Verdict "Blocking L1: ... A11Y-01 (2 finding(s)); A11Y-04 (1 finding(s))", F-0011 "No visible focus indicator ... Also: WCAG 2.4.7 Focus visible", F-0012 "Paste blocked in a credential field ... Also: WCAG 3.3.8 Accessible authentication, minimum", and the WCAG table marks 1.4.3, 1.4.11, 2.4.7, 2.5.8 and 3.3.8 as fail with their finding IDs. B: The reply says what blocks L1 and names it in plain words: "The first level is blocked by two things: Open accessibility problems: the six listed below. Checks that haven't run: the tool's self-test, a replay of the full seller journey, and the image and page-speed checks." The six are then stated without codes: "No focus outline: form fields show no visible outline, so keyboard users can't see where they are" (2.4.7); "Paste blocked: the password field blocks pasting, which gets in the way of password managers" (3.3.8); "Pale hint text: ... 2.5:1 contrast; the minimum is 4.5:1" (1.4.3); "Faint borders: ... 1.4:1; the minimum is 3:1" (1.4.11); "Small buttons: 'clear email' and 'show password' are 20 px; the minimum is 24 px" (2.5.8). Both examples the test names, paste blocking and focus, are present. The report backs this with the same blockers in its Verdict ("Blocking L1: EVD-02 ...; A11Y-01 (2 finding(s)); A11Y-04 (1 finding(s))") and ties each finding to its criterion ("Also: WCAG 3.3.8 Accessible authentication, minimum", "Also: WCAG 2.4.7 Focus visible"). The reply does not name the unrun G2 checks (dialogs, targets, forms, live regions, lang, cross-page) that the material's blocking list also carries, but the report's section 7 states each of those in plain words (e.g. "A11Y-06 Modal dialogs ... not_run — the dialogs check did not run"), and the test asks for the criteria that block L1 in plain words, which the reply gives for every confirmed G2 finding.
